title: OneWayExchanges
description: Give an item to a player by right clicking. Nice if on a skyblock or underwater/lava if you can't drop that item.
body:
# OneWayExchanges
OneWayExchanges is a tiny Neoforge mod (1.21.1) meant to improve quality of life in multiplayer Skyblock worlds and specific situations (like being underwater or in lava). The only feature you need to give items to another player safely!!
Just right click on another player to give one item of what you have in hand; or shift right-click to give the whole stack!
